- **Northern corn leaf blight**: Large cigar-shaped lesions — doesn't match

The light orange/yellow color and extremely dense, small pustule pattern is most consistent with **Southern rust**. Common rust pustules are darker (golden-brown to cinnamon) and more individually discrete, while the test image shows the characteristic dense, light-orange coverage of Southern rust.
